baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive causative sight at word 1 leads directly into the offender's wish, ransom verb, punishment, and sons at words 2, 5, 7, and 9.
baseline_models.mechanism: Compelled sight brings recognized persons into view; the offender's wish immediately recodes his own filiation as the substitute-price by which punishment might be displaced. Visibility initiates a one-way sacrificial exchange.

activation_trace.role: Enabled eye-sight supplies the compelled recognition that starts the exchange calculus.
Wishing for an outcome supplies the counterfactual desire to escape.
Guilt and offense identify the desiring subject as liable rather than as a neutral observer.
A ransom or substitute supplies the attempted transfer of danger from self to another.
Torment and punitive pain supply the pressure the exchange is meant to remove.
Filiation supplies actual sons as the offender's closest derived belonging and proposed price.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports that people see acquaintances and that an offender wants rescue.
changed_reading.after: Being made to see kin initiates a desperate substitution calculus in which the offender treats his own descendants as ransom-bearing extensions of himself.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative passive of ب ص ر at word 1 stands beside the liability noun from ج ر م at word 3 and the offender's exposed wish at word 2.
baseline_models.mechanism: Forced sight can operate inwardly as well as optically: the one who has incurred guilt is made to apprehend his condition, and the wish to purchase escape discloses the moral interior that ordinary seeing could leave hidden.

activation_trace.role: Inner sight and self-witness turn caused seeing into compelled moral apprehension.
Earning or causing liability supplies the offender's acquired relation to the crisis.
The offense branch fixes that acquired burden as culpability.
The wish gives the newly exposed interior a specific impossible direction.
Ransom renders the inward recognition legible as an attempted displacement of liability.

changed_reading.before: The opening verb merely makes other people visually identifiable.
changed_reading.after: The opening can also stage coerced self-witness: recognition of others exposes the offender's own culpability through the sacrifice he immediately desires.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence joins the cutting and liability possibilities of ج ر م, the substitution of ف د ي, and the filiation and construction images of ب ن ي.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sons remain literal descendants, but the construction branches let them also register as continuations and settled supports of the offender's house. He imagines cutting those supports away and putting them up in his place, preserving the isolated self by dismantling what extends it.

activation_trace.role: Cutting off and harvesting supplies the severing action in the proposed exchange.
Substitution gives the severed element its intended function as a protective price.
Building by joined parts supplies the household-structure analogy.
Filiation keeps the construction analogy anchored in the verse's actual sons.
Ribs and house-posts supply the image of descendants as load-bearing continuations of a life.

changed_reading.before: Offering sons is an isolated act of cruelty toward loved kin.
changed_reading.after: The offer is also self-disassembly: the offender would cut away the lineage supports that compose and continue his social self in order to preserve its bare center.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired seeing verbs assign the same coming event opposite scales: human sight casts it far away, while divine sight locates it near. The focus passive then reads as correction by event: what was mis-seen as distant becomes present, and recognition of one's human ties can no longer be deferred.

activation_trace.role: Caused eye-sight supplies the later compulsory recognition.
Eye-sight and insight supply the human act of estimating the event.
Distance from nearness supplies the human horizon of postponement.
The same sight branch supplies the counter-estimate rather than a different faculty.
Temporal nearness and completion collapse the delay presumed by the human view.

structural_cues: 70:6 and 70:7 repeat the seeing construction across opposed distance predicates before the passive causative sight of 70:11.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed estimates and later caused seeing; I infer a movement from active miscalibration to compelled presence. A live alternative is that the distance contrast dates the event without governing recognition of persons.

changed_reading.before: The focus opens an otherwise neutral spectacle of mutual recognition.
changed_reading.after: The spectacle is a forced recalibration: persons who treated the day as remote are made to see their ties inside the nearness they had misjudged.

context_deltas.mechanism: The overhead expanse becomes molten matter and hard elevations become soft wool. Against that material unmaking, the focus construction imagery is sharpened: descendants are the offender's settled lineage supports, yet he tries to render even them detachable and exchangeable when no apparently stable support remains stable.

activation_trace.role: House-posts and ribs supply the focus image of descendants as settled supports.
Filiation anchors those supports in actual sons rather than free material metaphor.
Ransom turns a support into proposed exchange matter.
The sky as what rises and overshadows supplies the largest apparent covering structure.
Molten substances and residues supply the sky's loss of stable form.
A hard elevated mass supplies the paradigm of material solidity.
Soft dyed wool supplies that solidity's loosened, manipulable state.

structural_cues: The paired similes of 70:8-9 transform sky and mountains immediately before the sequence turns to failed relations and kin-ransom.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two material transformations and focus construction branches; I supply the analogy from cosmic support-loss to social support-liquidation. The live alternative is that the similes establish spectacle only and do not organize the kinship sequence.

changed_reading.before: The sons are only beloved persons selected as an extreme price.
changed_reading.after: They also register as the first load-bearing lineage support made exchangeable in a world where apparently permanent structures have lost their form.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding line removes request and concern between intimates, while the focus restores visual access to them. Sight therefore does not repair relation: the visible intimate becomes material for the singular offender's own rescue wish instead of an interlocutor whose condition is asked about.

activation_trace.role: Enabled eye-sight makes the other present without guaranteeing care.
Questioning and requesting supply the relational act that is explicitly absent.
Near kinship and intimacy identify the very relation from which inquiry collapses.
The singular wish replaces mutual inquiry with a self-directed counterfactual.
Ransom converts visible relation into a one-way protective substitution.
Filiation makes the failure of solicitude maximally intimate.

structural_cues: 70:10 negates asking between two intimates; 70:11 opens with a passive plural and object pronoun before narrowing to one offender's wish.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies absent inquiry, intimate relation, caused sight, and ransom; I infer that sight without asking becomes instrumentalization. A live alternative is that terror merely blocks speech and the ransom wish is a separate reaction.

changed_reading.before: Being shown one another overcomes separation and permits recognition.
changed_reading.after: Recognition without solicitude intensifies the rupture: the other is fully visible yet approached only as a possible shield for the self.

context_deltas.mechanism: The proposed price expands from sons through spouse, brother, protective clan, and everyone on earth, while the desired result remains the offender's separated escape. The focus is thus the first ring of a widening liquidation of every relation around an isolated self.

activation_trace.role: Filiation supplies the first and closest stated ring of the ransom inventory.
Ransom gives every subsequently listed relation the same proposed substitution function.
Companionship and abiding association extend the price into the household bond.
Brotherhood and kinship add a lateral blood relation to the offer.
The man's clan expands the price from household persons to the kin-group.
Gathering shelter identifies that clan as the protection the offender would sacrifice.
Wholeness without remainder pushes the inventory to total inclusion.
Escape by separation supplies the unchanged goal at the end of the expanding offer.

structural_cues: The coordinated list in 70:12-14 continues the focus's ransom price and delays the rescue verb until after universal inclusion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered list, sheltering clan, totality, and escape; I infer concentric social distance and liquidation around the self. A live alternative is that the order marks rhetorical accumulation without a strict proximity ranking.

changed_reading.before: The sons are one shocking ransom option.
changed_reading.after: The sons open a systematic outward expansion in which household, kin-group, shelter, and finally the whole human field are liquidated for one person's separated survival.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering and enclosing value, withholding good, and the counter-image of a fixed claim for requester and deprived create a moral economy around the focus. Under punishment, possessiveness reverses into liquidation, but still perversely: the offender would spend descendants for himself after the human type had closed assets against legitimate outward claims.

activation_trace.role: Earning and causing liability connect acquisition to the offender's incurred burden.
Ransom supplies the emergency expenditure that reverses prior enclosure.
Filiation keeps the liquidated value anchored in persons, not ordinary property.
Joining scattered things into a collection supplies the acquisitive accumulation.
Putting a thing into a container supplies enclosure and retention after gathering.
Withholding the hand from giving supplies the closed direction of value.
Possessing and increasing wealth identifies the domain in which a different transfer is required.
A fixed obligatory entitlement supplies the rightful outward claim on accumulated value.
The requester supplies one legitimate recipient whom giving should answer.
Deprivation and missing the desired good supply the other legitimate recipient's need.

structural_cues: 70:18 compresses gathering and storing into one line; 70:21 names withholding; 70:24-25 reverse direction by locating an established claim within wealth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accumulation, enclosure, withholding, wealth, and rightful recipients; I infer that the focus ransom is a crisis reversal of the same possessive economy. A live alternative is that the focus offender and the later generic human portrait are related examples rather than one continuous type.

changed_reading.before: The offender's offer is desperate generosity at the last possible moment.
changed_reading.after: It is possessiveness under reversal: value finally flows outward only to buy the self, and even persons are treated as reserves while rightful claims had defined a non-self-serving economy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Continuance, enacted verification of the day of accounting, fear-inflected care, guarded practice, and standing witness form an anticipatory mode of perception. The focus sight is the inverse condition: perception arrives compulsorily and too late, revealing both liability and the wish to transfer it.

activation_trace.role: Inner sight and self-witness supply the focus's belated compelled apprehension.
Incurred liability supplies what late apprehension cannot undo.
Stillness and continuance supply sustained practice rather than crisis perception.
Making a promise true in deed supplies enacted verification of the coming day.
Accounting and recompense identify what is kept present before its arrival.
Care mixed with fear supplies an affective vigilance toward punishment.
Maintaining and adhering to an obligation supply guarded continuity.
Presence with direct witnessing supplies a practiced counterpart to forced sight.

structural_cues: The exception block is bracketed by repeated prayer language and places the day, punishment, entrusted obligations, and testimony inside recurring practices.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies durable practice, verification, accounting, fear, custody, and witness; I infer that these keep realities perceptually present before compulsory sight. A live alternative is that the middle block is ethical contrast without an epistemic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The offender simply lacked information until the day exposed it.
changed_reading.after: His sight is late rather than merely absent: the surah contrasts crisis-forced apprehension with practices that continually witness obligations, judgment, and vulnerability in advance.

context_deltas.mechanism: A sustained forward gaze toward the addressee, the focus's compelled sight, and the final humbled eyes form a visual reversal. Sight moves from presumptive orientation, through unavoidable recognition, to the bodily site overrun by humiliation; being made to see is exposure, not visual mastery.

activation_trace.role: Directing and sustaining the gaze supplies the earlier posture of confident visual approach.
Caused eye-sight supplies the compulsory midpoint of the reversal.
Lowering and submission turn the eyes from forward assertion into abjection.
The eye faculty explicitly relocates the focus's sight motif onto their own humbled gaze.
Overwhelming coverage makes humiliation something that masters and envelops them.
Brokenness under coercion supplies the terminal condition of the gaze.

structural_cues: The late plural eye noun repeats the focus root and attaches a lowered posture plus an engulfing predicate to the same people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sustained gaze, caused sight, humbled eyes, engulfing, and brokenness; I infer a visual arc from presumption to exposure to subjection. A live alternative is that the postures describe separate scenes without a continuous gaze mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Being made to see grants the offenders fuller visual access to others.
changed_reading.after: The access is punitive exposure within a gaze reversal: those who looked forward presumptively are forced to recognize and end with their own eyes mastered by humiliation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The offender imagines that he can manage substitution by placing sons where his punished self stands. The later sequence assigns effective replacement elsewhere: divine capacity can put others in their place, cannot be outstripped, and leaves them to meet the appointed event. Human ransom is exposed as counterfeit control inside a replacement order the offender does not govern.

activation_trace.role: Ransom and substitution supply the offender's attempted reassignment of exposure.
Filiation identifies the persons he presumes to place in his stead.
Effective capacity that reaches action and mastery supplies the actual power behind replacement.
One thing standing in another's place supplies an explicit counter-substitution.
Eluding a pursuer supplies the escape possibility that is denied.
What a person encounters, good or bad, supplies unavoidable arrival at the event.
An appointment fixed by time or place supplies the event's governed terminus.

structural_cues: 70:40-42 moves through capacity, replacement, inability to get ahead, and eventual encounter with the appointed day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine capacity and replacement, denied evasion, and appointed encounter; I map that sequence as a reversal of the focus ransom attempt. A live alternative is that replacing a people concerns succession only and does not answer the focus's exchange logic.

changed_reading.before: The ransom fails because the offered price is insufficient.
changed_reading.after: The deeper failure is agency: the offender performs an imagined substitution inside a scene where effective replacement belongs to a power he cannot outrun and whose appointment he must meet.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the blood-trace and blood-money edge of ب ص ر rather than its ordinary sight branch. It remains anchored by the focus's compelled seeing, ransom, offense, and actual filiation, which together can image sons as a visible blood-price. Downstream prose should present this only as a branch-generated material analogy, never as the lexical translation of the opening verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus itself places ب ص ر at word 1 beside offense, ransom, and sons at words 3, 5, and 9.

activation_trace.role: A visible blood trace with extensions to blood-revenge or blood-money supplies the outlier's material price image.
Guilt and offense supply the liability around which a blood-price image can gather.
Ransom supplies the explicit compensatory exchange.
Filiation supplies the actual blood relation that keeps the analogy attached to sons.

changed_reading.before: The visible persons merely furnish possible ransom victims.
changed_reading.after: At the branch-image level, compelled visibility can make the offender's own bloodline appear as the compensatory blood-price he wishes to tender.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from bodily mass and built constitution to literal sons, then reads the stripping of extremities as an analogy for lineage loss. It remains anchored by the focus's body, constitution, punishment, and filiation branches plus the context's removal imagery. Downstream prose should qualify it as an extended-body model, not claim that sons grammatically denote organs or that 70:16 directly glosses 70:11.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The offender, punishment, and sons permit a contained analogy between the culpable body and the descendants who constitute its extension.

activation_trace.role: Bodily frame and mass supply the central self whose boundaries the analogy extends.
Built constitution supplies the model of a self composed through related parts.
Filiation anchors the extended parts in actual descendants.
Punitive pain supplies the force against which bodily and lineage integrity fail.
Uprooting a thing from its fixed place supplies forcible disassembly.
Extremities and non-vital body parts supply the image of an extended body stripped from its center.

changed_reading.before: The offender tries to preserve his body by giving unrelated external victims.
changed_reading.after: The sons can be carried as an extended body: offering them anticipates the punitive stripping of the very continuations and supports through which the self exceeds its physical center.

strongest_changes: Compelled sight became a correction of temporal and moral misperception rather than neutral visual disclosure.
The sons became the first ring in a widening liquidation of every protective relation around an isolated self.
The ransom attempt became a possessive economy in reverse, opposed both to rightful outward claims and to sustained anticipatory witness.
Human substitution was exposed as counterfeit agency under divine replacement, unavoidable encounter, and a final reversal of the gaze.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots supported two unusually productive crossings: ب ن ي joined literal filiation to built supports, and ب ص ر joined forced recognition to self-witness and, at the contained edge, a visible blood-price. Context then converted these from isolated word-images into temporal, social, economic, material, and visual mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The precise antecedent and reciprocity of the object pronoun in the opening passive remain structurally open.
The construction, cosmic-collapse, blood-price, and extended-body readings remain analogical activations rather than lexical replacements.
The degree to which the later generic human portrait identifies the focus offender, rather than merely contrasting with him, remains uncertain.
